description:
[WRITE] Record one successful repayment against a wallet's ladder.

Advances the limit deterministically: 1 repayment -> $25, 3 -> $50, 6 -> $100,
10 -> $250 and status graduated, at which point the bureau's standard
underwriting decides the real limit and APR. Refuses after a default.
name: record_credit_ladder_repayment
title: Record Credit Ladder Repayment
